frozen.source_models: Unchanged family-specific Stage31 source models and native source priors from each source_search_manifest.
frozen.initial_policies: Use unchanged source-only design80 to construct the same physicalinitial10 in both streams of each geometry; each stream draws its own10 observations shared across its seven histories.
frozen.shared_neighbors: Each stream independently applies the unchanged shared64 generator to its own STOP engine; physically shared across arms within that stream. No bank or raw observation is copied from the other stream.
frozen.frontend: Unchanged original frontend and shared-neighbor supplement; adaptive proposals continue to learn from each arm own new history.
frozen.terminal: Unchanged old/default same_policy_distinct_challenger only; original shortlist and objective guard, safety80/128/128, comparison8 per policy, total cap352.

randomness.optimizer_seed: Same geometry_task_seed as config.seed in both streams; observation and verification seeds do not replace the optimizer seed.
randomness.observation_stream: SeedSequence([observation_seed, evaluation_index, SIMULATION_STREAM_TAG]); indices0..9 initialization and10..12 adaptive queries.
randomness.verification_stream: Use registered independent verification_seed with unchanged slot/replication/safety/objective stream namespaces.
randomness.pairing: Within each task/replicate all arms use matching observation and verification namespaces. Same evaluation index can query different policies; shared random numbers do not make responses identical.
randomness.limitation: New observations can change adaptive pools, trajectories and RNG consumption. Fixed optimizer seed does not freeze every per-policy TS innovation.
randomness.reuse: Never reuse old observations or certificates across the new streams. Only exactly matching new-stream physical observations may be shared with explicit accounting.
randomness.cross_stream: Independent registered observation and verification namespaces. Same source-only initial physical design and geometry; each stream generates its own shared64 from its own STOP state, so realized banks and adaptive pools may differ.
randomness.planning_scope: Historical Stage76 streams reused a previously frozen shared64 bank. Their two-stream variance is a planning scenario, not a guarantee for fresh geometries whose banks follow their own STOP observations; the separate new-geometry single-stream planning batch is not divided by two.

objective: Independently confirm whether frozen prior cross-policy propagation improves actual deployment under the unchanged old terminal.
scope: New known-family geometries with two independent observation/verification streams. The original shared-neighbor generation rule is frozen; new realized banks depend on each stream own STOP state.
geometry_description: RNG2026120000; original family order; 48 successive shift U(-.035,.035)^3 and radius U(.95,1.05) draws per family. No geometry screening, replacement or truth access.
statistical_unit: 144 geometry units; average paired stream effects within each geometry. Streams, histories, policies and terminal cells are not independent geometry units.

barriers.before_sampling: Register all geometry metadata and both seed maps, frozen sources and rules; admit a dedicated old-only two-stream scheduler adapter before any science.
barriers.before_online: All288 stream-specific initial histories and shared64 banks are sealed or explicitly failed before any adaptive search. Initial physical policies must match across streams; raw observations and derived banks are not copied.
barriers.before_verification: Seal all2016 histories or retained failures, then all2592 old-terminal inputs or explicit missing records before verification.
barriers.before_scoring: Seal all2592 old-terminal outcomes or retained failures across both streams, then freeze the complete saved action-pool and terminal/deployment policy inventory before target truth access or scoring.
barriers.failure: Keep every failure, paid prefix and CPU. No automatic retry, geometry replacement, task dropping, interim scoring or parameter changes.

analysis.primary: Old/default AFTER-minus-POINT C and signedG; average the two observation-stream paired effects within each geometry before between-geometry summaries.
analysis.secondary: FULL-minus-AFTER; all nine controls including same-source GP, old backend, structural, STOP and both same-search native crosses under the same old terminal.
analysis.fixed_size: Exactly144 new geometries, 48 per known family, two observation/verification streams; no optional expansion or outcome-based screening.
analysis.uncertainty: Geometry is the independent unit. Report two streams separately and within-geometry averages; no division of historical single-stream variance by two. Planning half-widths are not guaranteed realized precision or power.
analysis.missing: Retain all registered denominators. Missing baseline or failed effects remain null; report defined-subset statistics separately and never replace missing values by zero.
analysis.concentration: Report all per-geometry effects, family directions, wins/ties/losses, positive and negative sums, largest positive contribution share. Also remove the single largest positive contribution for a labeled descriptive sensitivity only; never replace the full registered primary estimate.
analysis.decomposition: Report deltaG=deltaP-deltaL, with positive_gain_difference and avoided_POINT_loss signed separately; positive AFTER quality alone is not an AFTER-minus-POINT gain.
analysis.interpretation: Keep historical batches separate from this cohort. Same winner, same discovery branch and repeat sampling are distinct; discovery mechanisms require saved actual-returned observations, and repeat counts do not establish causal necessity.

mechanism_audit.population: Every saved action_ids candidate in all three prefixes of AFTER, POINT and FULL, initial10 and all nine old-terminal shortlists/deployments; exact physical deduplication within geometry. All other controls retain their complete outcomes even where saved mechanism evidence is unavailable.
mechanism_audit.observations: Unobserved means absent from that arm history strictly before the current query; also track the same initially-unobserved set through all3 prefixes without replacing it by final survivors.
mechanism_audit.safety: True feasibility is chance_margin<=0 from the analytic target functions after sealing; sampled search eligibility is saved sampled_margin<=0. Report all4 combinations. Source-terminal probability<=0.5 is a different quantity.
mechanism_audit.coverage: For every arm/prefix/task record unobserved count, truly feasible unobserved count, sampled-eligible feasible unobserved count, safe improving count, and whether at least2 safe unobserved policies compete. Zero coverage and unavailable rows stay in the24-task report.
mechanism_audit.ranking: Use existing complete-pool saved mean and sampled scores after the global seal; no new posterior restoration, prediction or counterfactual score substitutions.
mechanism_audit.pairing: At prefix10 compare common physical candidates and initial history, checking pool/order equality before fixed-state attribution. In the common pool, retain both-unobserved true-feasible pairs and distinguish both sampled-eligible, one eligible, neither eligible and zero/one-policy sets. Later own-history comparisons are trajectory associations; intersections never replace full-pool coverage.
mechanism_audit.selection: Replay actual score argmax and fallback from saved arrays without model restoration or new draws; separate risk exclusion, mean ranking, sample reversal, repeated query and candidate absence. Keep every gain, tie and loss.
mechanism_audit.deployment: Follow every queried initially-unobserved policy into observed pool, frozen shortlist, safety, objective comparison and final deployment; join C,R,G,P,L. Merely containing a good candidate is not deployed value.
mechanism_audit.attribution_limit: Only the first divergence with identical saved history and pool supports same-state propagation comparison. Later differences are trajectory associations; no causal mediation or unseen alternative-history reward.
mechanism_audit.truth_account: Reuse same-geometry exact-policy truth only. At most3 new analytic function calls per distinct uncached policy (objective, constraint mean, constraint sigma); inventory N is fixed before truth, planned bound3N, actual missing-field calls charged separately. No simulation in audit.
mechanism_audit.execution_gap: Dedicated old-only two-stream execution and complete-pool scoring adapter remains unimplemented and unadmitted. Historical old/new runners are not execution entrypoints for this registration.
mechanism_audit.classification: Reuse the frozen Stage83 first-actual-returned-query classes: multiple safe unobserved competition, single safe unobserved competition, minimum violation, initial, other, unknown and unavailable saved path; repeat sampling is an orthogonal tag.
mechanism_audit.terminal_recording: Passively retain already computed final observed-pool components, ranking, shortlist construction and observation indices; no extra candidate scores or RNG draws.

execution_preparation.execution_policy: scheduleurm submit-cpu-batch explicit node001-node006, vram0, BLAS1; size workers from live free physical cores.
execution_preparation.remaining: Admitted for the frozen old-only two-stream stages and post-global-seal complete-pool audit.

name: mainline_precision_confirmation_v1

budget.bound_basis: One shared initial10 per stream/geometry; six histories pay three adaptive calls; nine separate old terminals. In the unchanged old verifier, the two-certified comparison path costs224 and the third-candidate fallback path costs336; those paths are mutually exclusive. The protocol ceiling remains352. Failed paid attempts and explicitly admitted recovery are additional retained costs, not hidden inside a successful-run bound.
budget.analytic_truth_function_call_bound: Three times the sealed distinct complete audit-policy inventory; no outcome-independent numeric inventory size is assumed. Charge actual missing analytic fields separately from simulation.

cohorts.name: old_geometries_two_independent_streams
cohorts.planning_scope: Simple geometry-level sample SD; family summaries do not replace the estimand. Historical-coverage projections concern available baseline-defined effects, not an imputed full-cohort mean. The all-defined scenario assumes future baseline availability. No variance reduction is assumed for adding a second stream.

within_geometry_stream_differences.identification: With independent identically distributed repetitions conditional on geometry, half the mean squared stream difference estimates an average composite stream variance. Observations, adaptive query paths and terminal verification all vary together; two repetitions do not separate simulator noise, search noise and verification noise. No between-geometry variance is obtained by subtraction, and no sqrt(2) precision gain is assumed.

precision_selection.selection_rule: First registered candidate N meeting both C and G plug-in halfwidth targets separately in both cohorts. Keep historical coverage, all signed effects and all registered geometries. Reference results, mean signs and leave-largest-positive sensitivity do not select N. No extrapolation beyond the registered candidate grid.
limits: Projected halfwidths are planning quantities, not utility thresholds or scientific acceptance criteria.
Plug-in variances and historical baseline coverage may change on fresh geometries; projected precision is not guaranteed.

The old two-stream cohort reused the Stage73 shared64 candidate bank, so its variance is conditional on that bank. Future streams will each generate their bank from their own STOP observations with the frozen generator; there is no observation-to-bank dependency across streams. The old variance does not guarantee precision under this change.
The two cohorts and observation repetitions are not pooled as independent geometries.
Undefined baselines stay undefined; conditional precision does not identify a full-cohort G mean.
Future two-stream execution receives no assumed sqrt(2) gain from the single-stream cohort.
